adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, the code iterates `usernames.split(",")` and only adds a user if `User.find_by_username(username)` returns a record; otherwise it does nothing. It then calls `group.save` and returns `success_json` on save success, even if zero usernames matched and no users were added. That makes “no-op because all usernames were invalid” indistinguishable from “members added”, but the diff does not establish that this is incorrect behavior (prior code also silently ignored non-existent users), so it’s more an API/UX/feedback concern than a verifiable defect.
